synthesizedFacts.fact: Eczema, or atopic dermatitis, is a common skin condition in children that causes dry, itchy patches.
Moisturizers are essential in managing eczema by maintaining the skin barrier and preventing dryness.
Eczema can be triggered by environmental factors such as allergens, temperature changes, and irritants.
There is no cure for eczema, but symptoms can be managed with proper skincare and medication.
Topical steroids are often used to reduce inflammation in moderate to severe cases of eczema.
